what_it_does: Proposes CirSTAG, a method to rapidly analyze how circuit performance changes when individual component sizes or capacitances vary slightly. Traditional approaches require hundreds of simulations which is too slow for large chips. Uses neural network graph analysis to compute a circuit stability score equivalent to the Lipschitz constant—a mathematical measure of how sensitive outputs are to input changes. When mapping distortion occurs (nearby nodes in input space map far apart in output space), this indicates circuit elements critical for stability.
